pairs: God has stood in the synagogue of gods, but,
in their midst, he decides between gods.
How long will you judge unjustly
and favor the faces of sinners?
Judge for the indigent and the orphan.
Do justice to the humble and the poor.
et egenum de manu peccatoris liberate.
and free the needy from the hand of the sinner.
All the foundations of the earth will be moved.
and all of you are sons of the Most High.
But you will die like men,
et sicut unus de principibus cadetis.
and you will fall just like one of the princes.
quoniam tu hæreditabis in omnibus gentibus.
For you will inherit it with all the nations.
